title: Scan document: turn paper into a PDF with the camera, in chats and email
text: The attach menu in TD Talk, the Marketing chat, WhatsApp and staff Portal Chats now has Scan document: point the live camera at a paper and it becomes one PDF. The same small menu (Scan document or Photo or file) is now in the Inbox reply and forward windows, the Portal Chats email panel and the New Email window. A scanned PDF goes through the same checks as a file you pick.
points: The menu now opens on the side that has room, so Scan document is no longer cut off on a phone's Reply screen. The computer layout is unchanged.
